project_pointcloud_to_camera: project a 3D point cloud into 2D pixel coordinates using a camera model
depth_to_points: back-project 2D pixel coordinates and depth values into 3D points in the camera frame
resample_image: resample an image at arbitrary floating-point coordinate positions with bilinear interpolation
resize_image_and_camera: resize an image and scale its camera intrinsics to preserve back-projection geometry
raster_coordinates: generate a grid of 2D or 3D pixel coordinates for a given raster shape
